# Cost per serving calculator

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/serving-cost/

Combine batch ingredients, packaging and overhead into a per-serving cost. This browser tool shows the inputs, assumptions and resulting output so you can use it for a specific everyday task.

## How to use it

1. Enter your own values or choose a supported file.
2. Adjust the options and run the tool.
3. Review the result, then copy, export or save it when available.

## Example

Divide a batch cost and packaging/overhead allowance by eight portions.

## Limits and checks

Portion sizes and overhead are your inputs. Suggested selling prices use an entered margin and do not guarantee a business profit.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
